steps.what: Teach fitness classes with demonstrations, participant observation and adapted instruction

tasks.design: Keep class teaching, demonstrations and observation with the coordinator. Existing plans in {DOCS} support live instruction without assuming that digital content removes physical teaching time.
tasks.previous_blocker: Instruction depends on participants' observed movement and needs.
tasks.still_hard: Adapt instruction while monitoring the class.
tasks.human_edge: Notice difficulty and offer appropriate individual guidance.
tasks.altitude: Own the quality of live fitness instruction.

evidence.claim: Live fitness teaching retains full time in this design.

assumptions: This baseline is teaching classes rather than a separate content-production task.
Existing documents suffice; no new automation or upkeep is introduced.
unknowns: Class size and participant support needs
research_questions: What work occurs outside required teaching and participant observation?

time_saved_range_pct.basis: B=100, R=100; gross and net 0. Teaching and participant attention remain.

tasks.savings_basis: 100 focal-role baseline hours; external labour excluded; incremental focal work deducted once; provisional

steps.what: Define campaign audiences, program facts, objectives and permitted healthy-lifestyle claims
Develop draft campaign messages and channel options from the verified brief

loop.purpose: Suggest campaign wording and channel options within the brief
loop.input: Verified program facts, approved claims, audience and objectives
loop.output: Campaign options with sources and explicit assumptions
loop.check: Coordinator verifies program facts, health implications, accessibility and audience fit
loop.stop: One revision then manual planning; no invented health benefits or testimonials
loop.why_not_simpler: Message framing and audience fit need language judgement beyond a fixed template

steps.what: Select campaign approach and finalize the marketing plan with stakeholders

tasks.design: Use the existing campaign template in {DOCS}, with a bounded drafting assistant where approved. The coordinator verifies claims and chooses the plan; publishing, audience-list handling and campaign spend remain outside this planning task.
tasks.previous_blocker: Messages need adaptation while health claims must stay accurate.
tasks.enabler_now: A source-bound language assistant can suggest wording from a completed brief.
tasks.still_hard: Choose motivating messages without misleading or stigmatizing people.
tasks.human_edge: Understand audience concerns and program fit.

ambition.what: Prepare an accessible campaign option for a previously underserved group, with separate review and delivery time.

tasks.altitude: Own campaign purpose and trustworthy program messaging.

evidence.claim: A language assistant can propose source-bound campaign wording; this specific wellness use and saving are model assumptions.

assumptions: The coordinator produces audience definition, objectives, program dates, price, access conditions, approved claims and source references in s1; its 35 hours includes capture and consultation.
Missing program facts or disputed health claims return to manual planning; no individual health data or inferred health segments enter the assistant.
Use native document templates and approved drafting facilities first.
Five additional focal hours per 100 baseline hours cover brief templates and claim-source upkeep.
Draft review is in s2, final selection in s3; execution and publication are outside this baseline.
research_questions: Does checked wording assistance reduce campaign planning time without increasing claim corrections?

time_saved_range_pct.basis: B=100, R=89.5; gross 10.5 minus 5 upkeep gives central net 5.5%. Range 0-5% allows extra claim correction; audience judgement and stakeholder agreement retain full time.

tasks.savings_basis: 100 focal-role baseline hours; external labour excluded; incremental focal work deducted once; provisional

steps.what: Select contractors after assessing qualifications, service fit and proposed terms
Supervise contractor delivery and resolve service concerns

tasks.design: Retain contractor assessment, selection and delivery supervision with the coordinator using {DOCS}. Existing purchasing authority and any required specialist checks remain part of the human process.
tasks.previous_blocker: Qualifications and proposals do not fully establish suitability or delivery quality.
tasks.enabler_now: Existing records support assessment and follow-up.
tasks.still_hard: Judge service fit and respond to observed concerns.
tasks.human_edge: Assess practitioner quality and maintain accountable relationships.

evidence.claim: Contractor selection and supervision remain judgement and relationship work in this design.

assumptions: The coordinator acts within existing purchasing authority; no automatic appointment or new authority is proposed.
No large repetitive screening or record-entry baseline is assumed.
Existing documents are sufficient and no new automation upkeep is introduced.
research_questions: Is there substantial repetitive administration distinct from contractor assessment and supervision?

time_saved_range_pct.basis: B=100, R=100; gross and net 0. Selection and supervision retain their time.

tasks.savings_basis: 100 focal-role baseline hours; external labour excluded; incremental focal work deducted once; provisional

steps.what: Define cost-containment comparisons and reconcile program cost and activity records
Track defined cost-containment measures and calculate comparable period differences
Evaluate strategy effectiveness and separate cost changes from service or activity changes

tasks.design: Configure comparisons in {SPREADSHEET} using costs reconciled to {ERP} and defined activity records. The coordinator interprets effectiveness and service trade-offs in {DOCS}; lower spending alone never becomes an automatic success classification.
tasks.previous_blocker: Cost records and program activity may cover different periods or populations.
tasks.enabler_now: Existing workbook functions can repeat defined comparisons.
tasks.still_hard: Establish whether the strategy caused savings without degrading service.
tasks.human_edge: Interpret confounding and make a defensible effectiveness judgement.

ambition.what: Review cost and activity comparisons at each completed reporting period.

tasks.altitude: Own evidence about program cost and service outcomes.

evidence.claim: A workbook can calculate explicitly defined comparisons; attributing effectiveness remains judgement and the saving is unmeasured.

assumptions: In s1 the coordinator produces strategy ID, implementation date, comparison periods, cost category, amount, currency, activity denominator, source and adjustment rationale; 40 hours includes extraction, capture and finance reconciliation.
Existing finance staff produce posted costs and existing event records supply activity data; extra reconciliation support is budgeted separately.
Missing periods, inconsistent populations or unsupported adjustments return to manual analysis rather than inferred values.
Use native financial reports and workbook functions first.
Seven extra focal hours and two other-role hours per 100 baseline hours cover comparison definitions and reconciliation support.
This is retrospective cost-strategy evaluation; budget scenario preparation and event capture are owned by their separate tasks and earn no duplicate saving here.
unknowns: Consistency of cost categories and activity denominators
research_questions: Do repeated comparable-period calculations justify validation and upkeep after causal interpretation remains manual?

time_saved_range_pct.basis: B=100, R=75; gross 25 minus 7 focal upkeep gives central net 18%. Range 0-15% allows reconciliation and definition changes; existing automated comparisons save zero and effectiveness judgement remains.

tasks.savings_basis: 100 focal-role baseline hours; external labour excluded; incremental focal work deducted once; provisional

role.altitude: Own trustworthy wellness services, accessible participation campaigns and evidence about program value.
reach: Support recreation managers with inclusive campaign planning
Apply comparable-period cost analysis alongside operational managers
role.ambitious_version: A wellness coordinator who repeats defined cost calculations and checks draft campaign options while retaining participant teaching, contractor oversight and effectiveness judgement.
